contexts.text: Eden = love... Thus a garden in Eden on the east () = the intelligence of the celestial man which flows in through love from the Lord.

The garden planted by Jehovah God in Eden on the east, in the supreme sense, = the Lord Himself; in the inmost sense, which also is the universal sense, = the Lord's Kingdom, and Heaven, in which man is placed when he is made celestial.
That Eden = love. Illustrated.
A river out of Eden () = wisdom from love, which is Eden. AE 518:14.
Jehovah put the man into the garden of Eden (). By the garden of Eden are signified all things which appertain to the celestial man.
With him who wants to be wise from the world, his Eden is the love of self and of the world.
Such also are called the trees of Eden in Hell (); where the trees of Eden = the scientifics and Knowledges from the Word which they thus profane by means of reasonings.
To be cast out of the garden of Eden () = to be deprived of all intelligence and wisdom.
As Eden = love, it = wisdom, or the will of good.
To remove faith from its former seat, is signified by Cain dwelt towards the east of Eden ().
Towards the east of Eden = near the intellectual mind, where before there reigned love; and also near the rational mind, where before there reigned charity. (For) Eden = love.
As the understanding reigned in that mind instead of the will, or faith instead of love, it is said, that he dwelt towards the east of Eden....
The trees of Eden with which they would go down into the lower earth = the knowledges of the Knowledges of faith.
The trees of Eden = perceptions.
In the Land of Canaan was the garden of Eden, by which is signified the intelligence and wisdom of the men of the Most Ancient Church. DP 241. DP 313. TCR 466. TCR 520. AE 739:6.
The regenerate man as to good is he who is compared to Eden ().
The garden of Eden = intelligence from good.
The precious stones in the garden of Eden = the truths of the sense of the letter of the Word.
The garden of Eden = wisdom and intelligence from the Word.
Hence Adam is described as to wisdom and intelligence by the garden of Eden...
Eden and the garden of God = wisdom and intelligence.
The garden in Eden = this wisdom.
The human mind in which charity is conjoined with faith, and faith with charity... is meant by the garden of Eden.
By the garden of Eden in the Word is not meant any garden, but intelligence... That the garden of Eden = intelligence and wisdom. Illustrated.
By the garden of Eden is meant intelligence in spiritual things from the love of truth.
The east of Eden () = where is the Lord's presence in celestial love.
To set the wilderness as Eden () = (that where there is no good there shall be good in abundance). Eden = good in abundance.
Eden in the garden of God () = the wisdom which is from the good of love.
The trees of Eden = the Knowledges of good from the Word.
Eden the garden of God () = intelligence through the Word from the Lord; for Eden, like the east, = the Lord.

That those who will be of that Church will acknowledge the Lord, and will receive love to Him and thence wisdom, is signified by He shall set the wilderness as Eden, and the solitude as the garden of Jehovah. Eden = love to the Lord; and the garden of Jehovah, = the wisdom thence derived.
The garden of Eden () = the understanding of truth from good, and thence wisdom.
